summary: Northeast breezes will strengthen and become strong this evening, pushing enough surf onto Franklin County beaches starting Wednesday for a high risk of rip current. A cold front on Wednesday night will shift winds around westerly or northwesterly on Thursday and Friday. These winds will push surf more directly at Panhandle beaches and increase the risk of rip currents.
